title: MPEG PES: Add other video and audio stream assignments
description:
While 0xc0 and 0xe0 are the first (0th) audio and video stream
assignments in Table 2-22 of ISO/IEC 13818-1, the table indicates
that 110x xxxx for any x is audio stream number x xxxx and
1110 xxxx is video stream number xxxx. Add those names so that
they are shown correctly instead of "unknown stream" (and we
can treat them as the appropriate types.)
